title: Integrate facts and managed Nix source
goal: After T001 and T002 are terminal and independently reviewed, integrate exactly their reviewed source commits into one dedicated non-main Heim-PC integration revision, prove the integration contains no unrelated source changes, validate it in an isolated integration worktree, publish an exact durable integration branch, and create a leased content-addressed whole-source artifact that becomes the only source for T004 and the mandatory base revision for T005.

approval.note: This task may read and mutate only the exclusively reserved Heim-PC Git object/ref store, its dedicated /home/alex/repos/.grabowski-heim-pc-nixos-t006-integration worktree and branch nixos-migration-v1-t006-integration as needed to create, validate and publish the exact non-main integration revision from the terminal T001/T002 commits, and may create the bound activation-source artifact. It does not merge to main and grants no runtime, storage, EFI, firmware, reboot or production-cutover authority.

acceptance.assertion: Integration begins only after T001 and T002 are terminal and independently reviewed; evidence binds each exact terminal Git commit/tree, its reviewed task evidence and the exact common integration base. Missing, dirty, unpublished or ambiguous source identity fails closed before integration mutation.

Before reading commit/tree objects or creating integration refs, the task holds the exclusive component.heim-pc.nixos-source-integration claim materialized as path:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git; lease loss or object/ref-store drift fails closed before another Git mutation.

All index/tree mutation and validation occurs only in the leased /home/alex/repos/.grabowski-heim-pc-nixos-t006-integration worktree on the leased non-main branch nixos-migration-v1-t006-integration. The productive Heim-PC checkout and main branch are not mutated; wrong branch, wrong worktree, dirty preimage or lease loss fails closed.

A dedicated non-main integration revision is produced from exactly the reviewed T001 and T002 terminal source revisions using a receipt-bound merge/rebase/cherry-pick plan. Any conflict is explicitly reviewed, and tree comparison proves the result contains the intended union of those changes plus no unrelated source delta.

While holding the exact branch lease repo:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc:branch:nixos-migration-v1-t006-integration, the exact integration commit is published only to that dedicated non-main branch and remote readback proves it resolves to the reviewed commit/tree. No moving branch name alone is accepted by successor tasks; the terminal receipt carries exact commit and tree identities.

Focused T001/T002 tests and required Heim-PC repository validation are green in the isolated integration worktree on the exact integration commit, and an independent review finds no material integration regression before the source artifact is published.

While holding the exclusive artifact.heim-pc.nixos-activation-source write claim, T006 creates a content-addressed whole-source artifact and immutable manifest from the exact reviewed integration commit. The manifest binds Git commit/tree, archive/content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity; immediate independent re-hash/readback proves artifact contents match the bound source tree.

The T006 terminal evidence designates the exact integration commit/tree as T005's mandatory immutable base and the content-addressed activation-source artifact as T004's only build-source input. Successors fail closed on any different base, artifact digest or source identity.
T006 performs no main-branch merge, production NixOS activation, partitioning, formatting, LUKS/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, reboot or equivalent production-cutover effect.
